detail.longDescription: I drafted an OSI-style model for AI agents and put it on my site. It's AIM, the Agent Interconnection Model, and it runs seven layers from Resource through Interaction, with MCP at L3 as the narrow waist and Agent Skills at L4. To keep the three C layers straight, the top-down mnemonic is "In Real Change Control, Capture Every Rollback." It's a mental model, not a standard. Tell me where it breaks. https:// ryanthomashuff.com/ai-research -education/agent-stack/ # MCP # AI # networking # AIAgents
